name: Animated Accordion Blueprint
description: Structured AI prompt blueprint to scaffold an accessible Radix-compatible collapsible accordion.

promptData.promptText: Create an accessible collapsible Accordion component in React 19 using Tailwind CSS. Include smooth height transition with CSS grid-template-rows, keyboard navigation (Arrow Up/Down, Enter, Space), and clear aria-expanded attributes.

name: Glassmorphism Card Blueprint
description: Structured prompt specification for a multi-layered frosted glass card with noise texture.

promptData.promptText: Design a high-fidelity glassmorphism card component with backdrop-filter: blur(16px), subtle 1px border gradient (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), and inner shadow. Ensure high legibility on both dark and light backgrounds.

name: Command Palette (Cmd+K) Blueprint
description: Production-grade prompt blueprint to build a keyboard-first global search modal.

promptData.promptText: Build a keyboard-first Omnibox command palette in React 19 triggered by Cmd+K or Ctrl+K. Include fuzzy search filtering across multiple resource categories, highlighted keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Escape to close), and recent search history stored in localStorage.
